name: cheapgen
description: Sends each AI video or image generation to the cheapest provider you have a key for (Kie, Replicate, WaveSpeed, fal). Quotes first and asks before spending.

settings.name: Kie API key
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key kie`.

settings.name: Replicate API key
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key replicate`.

settings.name: WaveSpeed API key
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key wavespeed`.

settings.name: fal API key
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key fal`.
